evaluatedOn: Measured on the 200 held-out evaluation household records in ReliefGov_Classification_Results.xlsx (test split, random_state=42) from Barangay Tambacan. Internal hold-out evaluation: not an external validation and not a real-world accuracy claim; provides decision support and queue prioritization.
perClassBasis: Recomputed directly from the 200 test classification rows in ReliefGov_Classification_Results.xlsx.

confusionMatrix.orientation: rows = actual (source dataset label), columns = model prediction
confusionMatrix.note: Evaluated across 9 multi-dimensional vulnerability and damage indicators: Purok, Sex, Age, Household Size, Ownership, Damage Classification, Disability Status, Flood Exposure, and Supporting Documents.

fullDataAgreement.evaluatedOn: Agreement across the collected household records for Barangay Tambacan (training-set agreement).

labelMapping: The model outputs uppercase ['LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH']; this system maps 'MEDIUM' to 'Moderate'. Class display order: Low, Moderate, High.
importanceBasis: Share of the 100-tree Random Forest total Gini impurity reduction across all 9 features.
